premises: Plasticity in single-phase BCC refractory HEAs is dominated by edge dislocations, not screws
Severe lattice distortion in these HEAs creates an effective barrier to dislocation glide
Edge dislocations in these HEAs move via a thermally activated super-jogging mechanism
This edge/super-jog mechanism causes a high-temperature yield strength plateau (~673–1073 K)
The mechanism produces thermoelastic behavior distinct from conventional BCC alloys
